sanskrit_shloka: घेरण्ड उवाच । समाधिश्च परो योगो बहुभाग्येन लभ्यते । गुरोः कृपाप्रसादेन प्राप्यते गुरुभक्तितः ॥
text: घेरण्ड उवाच । समाधिश्च परो योगो बहुभाग्येन लभ्यते । गुरोः कृपाप्रसादेन प्राप्यते गुरुभक्तितः ॥
transliteration: Gheraṇḍa uvāca | Samādhiśca paro yogo bahubhāgyena labhyate | Guroḥ kṛpāprasādena prāpyate gurubhaktitaḥ ||
translation: Gheranda said: Samadhi is the supreme yoga; it is obtained through great merit (good fortune). It is attained by the grace of the Guru and through devotion to the Guru.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Gheranda said: Samadhi is the supreme yoga; it is obtained through great merit (good fortune). It is attained by the grace of the Guru and through devotion to the Guru.
translations.text: Gheranda said: Samadhi is the supreme yoga; it is obtained through great merit (good fortune). It is attained by the grace of the Guru and through devotion to the Guru.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: घेरण्ड बोले: समाधि ही परम योग है; यह महान सौभाग्य से प्राप्त होता है। यह गुरु की कृपा और गुरुभक्ति के द्वारा प्राप्त किया जाता है।
translations.text: घेरण्ड बोले: समाधि ही परम योग है; यह महान सौभाग्य से प्राप्त होता है। यह गुरु की कृपा और गुरुभक्ति के द्वारा प्राप्त किया जाता है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Samadhi Yoga
commentary_faqs.answer: The necessity of Guru's grace and devotion for the attainment of the highest yogic state (Samadhi).

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: The verse highlights the psychological necessity of surrender and gratitude, which serves as a therapy for anxiety, ego-centric distress, and spiritual exhaustion.

sanskrit_shloka: विद्याप्रतीतिः स्वगुरुप्रतीतिरात्मप्रतीतिर्मनसः प्रबोधः । दिने दिने यस्य भवेत्स योगी सुशोभनाभ्यासमुपैति सद्यः ॥
text: विद्याप्रतीतिः स्वगुरुप्रतीतिरात्मप्रतीतिर्मनसः प्रबोधः । दिने दिने यस्य भवेत्स योगी सुशोभनाभ्यासमुपैति सद्यः ॥
transliteration: vidyāpratītiḥ svagurupratītirātmapratītirmanasaḥ prabodhaḥ | dine dine yasya bhavetsayogī suśobhanābhyāsamupaiti sadyaḥ ||
translation: The firm conviction in knowledge, the firm conviction in one's own Guru, the firm conviction in the Self, and the awakening of the mind—he in whom these occur day by day, that practitioner attains the most excellent state of meditative absorption immediately.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: The firm conviction in knowledge, the firm conviction in one's own Guru, the firm conviction in the Self, and the awakening of the mind—he in whom these occur day by day, that practitioner attains the most excellent state of meditative absorption immediately.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: विद्या में प्रतीति, अपने गुरु में प्रतीति, आत्म-प्रतीति और मन का प्रबोध (जागृति) जिसके हृदय में प्रतिदिन उदय होते हैं, वह योगी शीघ्र ही उत्तम अभ्यास (समाधि) को प्राप्त कर लेता है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Dhyana (Meditation) and Viveka (Discrimination)
commentary_faqs.answer: The foundational necessity of faith (pratīti) and self-awareness for spiritual attainment.

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Used to alleviate cognitive dissonance and psychological instability by anchoring the mind through faith and self-knowledge, helping to manage stress-induced mental fatigue.

sanskrit_shloka: घटाद्भिन्नं मनः कृत्वा ऐक्यं कुर्यात्परात्मनि । समाधिं तं विजानीयान्मुक्तसंज्ञो दशादिभिः ॥
text: घटाद्भिन्नं मनः कृत्वा ऐक्यं कुर्यात्परात्मनि । समाधिं तं विजानीयान्मुक्तसंज्ञो दशादिभिः ॥
transliteration: ghaṭādbhinnaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā aikyaṃ kuryāṭparātmani | samādhiṃ taṃ vijānīyānmuktasaṃjño daśādibhiḥ ||
translation: Having made the mind separate from the body (the pot), one should establish union with the Supreme Self. Know that state to be Samadhi, where one is considered liberated from the ten states and conditions.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Having made the mind separate from the body (the pot), one should establish union with the Supreme Self. Know that state to be Samadhi, where one is considered liberated from the ten states and conditions.
translations.text: Having made the mind separate from the body (the pot), one should establish union with the Supreme Self. Know that state to be Samadhi, where one is considered liberated from the ten states and conditions.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: मन को शरीर (घट) से भिन्न करके परमात्मा में उसका एकत्व (विलय) करना चाहिए। उस अवस्था को समाधि समझना चाहिए, जिसमें साधक दस दशाओं आदि से मुक्त हो जाता है।
translations.text: मन को शरीर (घट) से भिन्न करके परमात्मा में उसका एकत्व (विलय) करना चाहिए। उस अवस्था को समाधि समझना चाहिए, जिसमें साधक दस दशाओं आदि से मुक्त हो जाता है।

commentary_faqs.answer: Atma-aikya (Union of the individual consciousness with the Supreme)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Stress reduction and psychological detachment from somatic identification, aiding in psychosomatic healing.

sanskrit_shloka: अहं ब्रह्म न चान्योऽस्मि ब्रह्मैवाहं न शोकभाक् । सच्चिदानन्दरूपोऽहं नित्यमुक्तः स्वभाववान् ॥
text: अहं ब्रह्म न चान्योऽस्मि ब्रह्मैवाहं न शोकभाक् । सच्चिदानन्दरूपोऽहं नित्यमुक्तः स्वभाववान् ॥
transliteration: ahaṃ brahma na cānyo'smi brahmaivāhaṃ na śokabhāk | saccidānandarūpo'haṃ nityamuktaḥ svabhāvavān ||
translation: I am Brahman and nothing else; I am verily Brahman, not subject to grief. I am of the nature of Existence, Consciousness, and Bliss; I am eternally free and established in my own essential nature.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: I am Brahman and nothing else; I am verily Brahman, not subject to grief. I am of the nature of Existence, Consciousness, and Bliss; I am eternally free and established in my own essential nature.
translations.text: I am Brahman and nothing else; I am verily Brahman, not subject to grief. I am of the nature of Existence, Consciousness, and Bliss; I am eternally free and established in my own essential nature.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: मैं ब्रह्म ही हूँ, उससे भिन्न कुछ नहीं हूँ। मैं साक्षात् ब्रह्म हूँ, मैं शोक का भागी नहीं हूँ। मैं सच्चिदानंद स्वरूप हूँ, मैं नित्य मुक्त हूँ और अपने स्वभाव में स्थित हूँ।
translations.text: मैं ब्रह्म ही हूँ, उससे भिन्न कुछ नहीं हूँ। मैं साक्षात् ब्रह्म हूँ, मैं शोक का भागी नहीं हूँ। मैं सच्चिदानंद स्वरूप हूँ, मैं नित्य मुक्त हूँ और अपने स्वभाव में स्थित हूँ।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Jnana Yoga / Nididhyasana
commentary_faqs.answer: Atma-Brahma-Aikya (Non-duality of Self and Brahman)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: The cultivation of Self-identity as Brahman serves as a cognitive intervention for existential anxiety and psychological trauma, promoting emotional stability through the de-identification with the suffering ego.

sanskrit_shloka: शाम्भव्या चैव भ्रामर्या खेचर्या योनिमुद्रया । ध्यानं नादं रसानन्दं लयसिद्धिश्चतुर्विधा ॥
text: शाम्भव्या चैव भ्रामर्या खेचर्या योनिमुद्रया । ध्यानं नादं रसानन्दं लयसिद्धिश्चतुर्विधा ॥
transliteration: śāmb dravyā caiva bhrāmaryā khecaryā yonimudrayā | dhyānaṃ nādaṃ rasānandaṃ layasiddhiścaturvidhā ||
translation: Through Shambhavi, Bhramari, Khechari, and Yoni mudra, four kinds of Laya-siddhi (dissolution attainment) occur: Dhyana (meditation), Nada (inner sound), Rasananda (bliss of taste), and Laya (absorption).

translations.author: English Translation

translations.text: शाम्भवी, भ्रामरी, खेचरी और योनि मुद्रा के माध्यम से लयसिद्धि चार प्रकार की होती है: ध्यान, नाद, रसानन्द और लय।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Shambhavi Mudra, Bhramari Mudra, Khechari Mudra, Yoni Mudra
commentary_faqs.answer: Laya-siddhi (Attainment of dissolution)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: The practice of these mudras is beneficial for reducing stress, stabilizing the nervous system, and managing psychosomatic disorders through deep internal absorption.

sanskrit_shloka: पञ्चधा भक्तियोगेन मनोमूर्च्छा च षड्विधा । षड्विधोऽयं राजयोगः प्रत्येकमवधारयेत् ॥
text: पञ्चधा भक्तियोगेन मनोमूर्च्छा च षड्विधा । षड्विधोऽयं राजयोगः प्रत्येकमवधारयेत् ॥
transliteration: pañcadhā bhaktiyogena manomūrcchā ca ṣaḍvidhā । ṣaḍvidho'yaṃ rājayogaḥ pratyekamavadhārayet ॥
translation: Bhakti Yoga is five-fold, and Mano-murcha is six-fold. This Raja Yoga is also six-fold; one should understand each of these distinctly.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Bhakti Yoga is five-fold, and Mano-murcha is six-fold. This Raja Yoga is also six-fold; one should understand each of these distinctly.

sanskrit_shloka: शाम्भवीं मुद्रिकां कृत्वा आत्मप्रत्यक्षमानयेत् । बिन्दु ब्रह्ममयं दृष्ट्वा मनस्तत्र नियोजयेत् ॥
text: शाम्भवीं मुद्रिकां कृत्वा आत्मप्रत्यक्षमानयेत् । बिन्दु ब्रह्ममयं दृष्ट्वा मनस्तत्र नियोजयेत् ॥
transliteration: śāmbhavīṁ mudrikāṁ kṛtvā ātmapratyakṣamānayet । bindu brahmamayaṁ dṛṣṭvā manastatra niyojayet ॥
translation: Having performed the Shambhavi Mudra, one should bring forth the perception of the Self. Having witnessed the point (Bindu) as identical to Brahman, one should fix the mind therein.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Having performed the Shambhavi Mudra, one should bring forth the perception of the Self. Having witnessed the point (Bindu) as identical to Brahman, one should fix the mind therein.

commentary_faqs.answer: Dhyana-Yoga-Samadhi (Absorption through meditative focus)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Used for psychological grounding and stabilizing mental fluctuations (anxiety and over-thinking)

sanskrit_shloka: खमध्ये कुरु चात्मानमात्ममध्ये च खं कुरु । आत्मानं खमयं दृष्ट्वा न किञ्चिदपि बाधते । सदानन्दमयो भूत्वा समाधिस्थो भवेन्नरः ॥
text: खमध्ये कुरु चात्मानमात्ममध्ये च खं कुरु । आत्मानं खमयं दृष्ट्वा न किञ्चिदपि बाधते । सदानन्दमयो भूत्वा समाधिस्थो भवेन्नरः ॥
transliteration: khamadhye kuru cātmānamātmamadhye ca khaṃ kuru | ātmānaṃ khamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā na kiñcidapi bādhate | sadānandamayo bhūtvā samādhistho bhavennaraḥ ||
translation: Establish the self within the void (space/consciousness) and establish the void within the self. Having perceived the self as being composed of the void, nothing at all can obstruct or afflict one. Thus, becoming filled with eternal bliss, the human attains the state of Samadhi.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Establish the self within the void (space/consciousness) and establish the void within the self. Having perceived the self as being composed of the void, nothing at all can obstruct or afflict one. Thus, becoming filled with eternal bliss, the human attains the state of Samadhi.

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance

sanskrit_shloka: अथ नादयोगसमाधिः । अनिलं मन्दवेगेन भ्रामरीकुम्भकं चरेत् । मन्दं मन्दं रेचयेद्वायुं भृङ्गनादं ततो भवेत् ॥
text: अथ नादयोगसमाधिः । अनिलं मन्दवेगेन भ्रामरीकुम्भकं चरेत् । मन्दं मन्दं रेचयेद्वायुं भृङ्गनादं ततो भवेत् ॥
transliteration: atha nādayogasamādhiḥ | anilaṃ mandavegena bhrāmarīkumbhakaṃ caret | mandaṃ mandaṃ recayedvāyuṃ bhṛṅganādaṃ tato bhavet ||
translation: Now, the meditation of the Yoga of Sound (Nadayoga). One should perform the Bhramari Kumbhaka (bee-breath breath retention) with a gentle speed. Exhale the breath very slowly and gently; from that, the buzzing sound of a bee will arise.

translations.author: English Translation

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Bhramari Pranayama
commentary_faqs.answer: Nadayoga (Union through sound)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance

sanskrit_shloka: अन्तःस्थं भ्रमरीनादं श्रुत्वा तत्र मनो नयेत् । समाधिर्जायते तत्र आनन्दः सोऽहमित्यतः ॥
text: अन्तःस्थं भ्रमरीनादं श्रुत्वा तत्र मनो नयेत् । समाधिर्जायते तत्र आनन्दः सोऽहमित्यतः ॥
transliteration: antaḥsthaṃ bhramarīnādaṃ śrutvā tatra mano nayet | samādhirjāyate tatra ānandaḥ so'hamityataḥ ||
translation: Having listened to the inner humming sound resembling a bumblebee, one should fix the mind therein. In that state, Samadhi arises, and from the realization 'I am That' (So'ham), great bliss is attained.

sanskrit_shloka: खेचरीमुद्रासाधनाद्रसनोर्ध्वगता यदा । तदा समाधिसिद्धिः स्याद्धित्वा साधारणक्रियाम् ॥
text: खेचरीमुद्रासाधनाद्रसनोर्ध्वगता यदा । तदा समाधिसिद्धिः स्याद्धित्वा साधारणक्रियाम् ॥

translation: When, through the practice of Khechari Mudra, the tongue is turned upwards, then, by abandoning all ordinary activities, the perfection of Samadhi is attained.

commentary_faqs.answer: Union of the tongue with the upper palate to induce meditative absorption (Samadhi).

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: The practice of Khechari Mudra is traditionally associated with balancing the endocrine system and calming the nervous system, potentially aiding in chronic stress reduction and hypertension.

sanskrit_shloka: योनिमुद्रां समासाद्य स्वयं शक्तिमयो भवेत् । सुश‍ृङ्गाररसेनैव विहरेत्परमात्मनि ॥

transliteration: yonimudrāṃ samāsādya svayaṃ śaktimayo bhavet । suśṛṅgārarasenaiva viharetparamātmani ॥
translation: Having attained the Yoni Mudra, one becomes the embodiment of Shakti (divine energy) itself. Immersed in the supreme nectar of sublime union, one dwells in the Supreme Self.

sanskrit_shloka: आनन्दमयः सम्भूत्वा ऐक्यं ब्रह्मणि सम्भवेत् । अहं ब्रह्मेति चाऽद्वैतं समाधिस्तेन जायते ॥
text: आनन्दमयः सम्भूत्वा ऐक्यं ब्रह्मणि सम्भवेत् । अहं ब्रह्मेति चाऽद्वैतं समाधिस्तेन जायते ॥
transliteration: ānandamayaḥ sambhūtvā aikyaṃ brahmaṇi sambhavet | ahaṃ brahmeti cā'dvaitaṃ samādhistena jāyate ||
translation: Having attained the state of bliss (ānandamaya), one should unite with Brahman. By the realization 'I am Brahman,' non-duality is established, and thereby Samadhi (deep meditative absorption) is attained.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Having attained the state of bliss (ānandamaya), one should unite with Brahman. By the realization 'I am Brahman,' non-duality is established, and thereby Samadhi (deep meditative absorption) is attained.

sanskrit_shloka: अथ भक्तियोगसमाधिः । स्वकीयहृदये ध्यायेदिष्टदेवस्वरूपकम् । चिन्तयेद्भक्तियोगेन परमाह्लादपूर्वकम् ॥
text: अथ भक्तियोगसमाधिः । स्वकीयहृदये ध्यायेदिष्टदेवस्वरूपकम् । चिन्तयेद्भक्तियोगेन परमाह्लादपूर्वकम् ॥
transliteration: atha bhaktiyogasamādhiḥ. svakīyahṛdaye dhyāyed iṣṭadevasvarūpakam. cintayed bhaktiyogena paramāhlādapūrvakam.
translation: Now, the meditation of devotion (Bhakti Yoga Samadhi). In one's own heart, one should meditate upon the form of the chosen deity. One should contemplate (this) with the power of devotion, accompanied by supreme bliss.

translations.author: English Translation

sanskrit_shloka: आनन्दाश्रुपुलकेन दशाभावः प्रजायते । समाधिः सम्भवेत्तेन सम्भवेच्च मनोन्मनी ॥
text: आनन्दाश्रुपुलकेन दशाभावः प्रजायते । समाधिः सम्भवेत्तेन सम्भवेच्च मनोन्मनी ॥
transliteration: ānandāśrupulakena daśābhāvaḥ prajāyate | samādhiḥ sambhavettena sambhavecca manonmanī ||
translation: From the state of joyful tears and horripilation, a transformation of the state of consciousness occurs. Through this, Samadhi manifests, and subsequently, the state of Manonmani (the dissolution of the mind) also arises.

sanskrit_shloka: अथ राजयोगसमाधिः । मनोमूर्च्छां समासाद्य मन आत्मनि योजयेत् । परात्मनः समायोगात्समाधिं समवाप्नुयात् ॥

translation: Now, the meditation of Rajayoga. Having attained the state of mental absorption (Manomurccha), one should unite the mind with the Self. Through the union with the Supreme Self, one attains Samadhi.

commentary_faqs.answer: This technique is highly relevant for the management of anxiety, restlessness, and hyper-arousal of the autonomic nervous system by inducing a state of deep mental withdrawal and physiological rest.

sanskrit_shloka: अथ समाधियोगमाहात्म्यम् । इति ते कथितं चण्ड समाधिर्मुक्तिलक्षणम् । राजयोगः समाधिः स्यादेकात्मन्येव साधनम् । उन्मनी सहजावस्था सर्वे चैकात्मवाचकाः ॥
text: अथ समाधियोगमाहात्म्यम् । इति ते कथितं चण्ड समाधिर्मुक्तिलक्षणम् । राजयोगः समाधिः स्यादेकात्मन्येव साधनम् । उन्मनी सहजावस्था सर्वे चैकात्मवाचकाः ॥
transliteration: atha samādhiyogamāhātmyam | iti te kathitaṃ caṇḍa samādhir-muktilakṣaṇam | rājayogaḥ samādhiḥ syādekātmanyeva sādhanam | unmanī sahajāvasthā sarve caikātmavācakāḥ ||

sanskrit_shloka: जले विष्णुः स्थले विष्णुर्विष्णुः पर्वतमस्तके । ज्वालामालाकुले विष्णुः सर्वं विष्णुमयं जगत् ॥

translations.text: जल में विष्णु हैं, स्थल में विष्णु हैं, और पर्वत के शिखर पर भी विष्णु हैं। ज्वालाओं की माला से आकुल अग्नि में भी विष्णु ही हैं; यह संपूर्ण संसार विष्णुमय है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Dhyana (Meditation on the omnipresence of the Divine)
commentary_faqs.answer: Sarva-Vishnu-Maya (The doctrine of universal immanence)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Cultivation of a sense of connectedness to reduce existential anxiety, feelings of isolation, and psychosomatic stress.

sanskrit_shloka:
भूचराः खेचराश्चामी यावन्तो जीवजन्तवः ।
वृक्षगुल्मलतावल्लीतृणाद्या वारिपर्वताः ।
सर्वं ब्रह्म विजानीयात्सर्वं पश्यति चात्मनि ॥
text:
भूचराः खेचराश्चामी यावन्तो जीवजन्तवः ।
वृक्षगुल्मलतावल्लीतृणाद्या वारिपर्वताः ।
सर्वं ब्रह्म विजानीयात्सर्वं पश्यति चात्मनि ॥
transliteration: bhūcarāḥ khecarāścāmī yāvanto jīvajantavaḥ | vṛkṣagulmalatāvallītṛṇādyā vāriparvatāḥ | sarvaṃ brahma vijānīyātsarvaṃ paśyati cātmani ||
translation: Those that move on the earth, those that move in the sky, as many living creatures as there are, trees, shrubs, creepers, vines, grasses, and the like, as well as waters and mountains—one should understand all of this to be Brahman, and one should see all of this within the Self.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Those that move on the earth, those that move in the sky, as many living creatures as there are, trees, shrubs, creepers, vines, grasses, and the like, as well as waters and mountains—one should understand all of this to be Brahman, and one should see all of this within the Self.
translations.text: Those that move on the earth, those that move in the sky, as many living creatures as there are, trees, shrubs, creepers, vines, grasses, and the like, as well as waters and mountains—one should understand all of this to be Brahman, and one should see all of this within the Self.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: भूमि पर चलने वाले, आकाश में विचरने वाले, जितने भी जीव-जंतु हैं, वृक्ष, गुल्म (झाड़ियाँ), लता, वल्लियाँ, तृण आदि और जल तथा पर्वत; इन सबको ब्रह्म के रूप में जानना चाहिए और सबको अपनी आत्मा में ही देखना चाहिए।
translations.text: भूमि पर चलने वाले, आकाश में विचरने वाले, जितने भी जीव-जंतु हैं, वृक्ष, गुल्म (झाड़ियाँ), लता, वल्लियाँ, तृण आदि और जल तथा पर्वत; इन सबको ब्रह्म के रूप में जानना चाहिए और सबको अपनी आत्मा में ही देखना चाहिए।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Jnana Yoga / Nididhyasana
commentary_faqs.answer: Sarvam Khalvidam Brahma (Everything is indeed Brahman)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Cultivation of universal empathy and ego-dissolution to alleviate existential anxiety, psychosomatic tension, and feelings of isolation.

sanskrit_shloka: आत्मा घटस्थचैतन्यमद्वैतं शाश्वतं परम् । घटाद्विभिन्नतो ज्ञात्वा वीतरागं विवासनम् ॥
text: आत्मा घटस्थचैतन्यमद्वैतं शाश्वतं परम् । घटाद्विभिन्नतो ज्ञात्वा वीतरागं विवासनम् ॥
transliteration: ātmā ghaṭasthacaitanyamadvaitaṃ śāśvataṃ param । ghaṭādvibhinnato jñātvā vītarāgaṃ vivāsanam ॥
translation: The Self is the consciousness abiding within the body-pot, non-dual, eternal, and supreme. Having realized it as distinct from the body, one becomes free from attachments and devoid of desires.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: The Self is the consciousness abiding within the body-pot, non-dual, eternal, and supreme. Having realized it as distinct from the body, one becomes free from attachments and devoid of desires.
translations.text: The Self is the consciousness abiding within the body-pot, non-dual, eternal, and supreme. Having realized it as distinct from the body, one becomes free from attachments and devoid of desires.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: आत्मा शरीररूपी घड़े में स्थित चैतन्य है, जो अद्वैत, शाश्वत और परम है। उसे घड़े (शरीर) से भिन्न जानकर मनुष्य वीतराग (राग से रहित) और विवासन (वासनाओं से मुक्त) हो जाता है।
translations.text: आत्मा शरीररूपी घड़े में स्थित चैतन्य है, जो अद्वैत, शाश्वत और परम है। उसे घड़े (शरीर) से भिन्न जानकर मनुष्य वीतराग (राग से रहित) और विवासन (वासनाओं से मुक्त) हो जाता है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Viveka (Discernment) and Dhyana (Meditation)
commentary_faqs.answer: Atma-Anatma Viveka (Discrimination between Self and Non-self)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Psychosomatic stress reduction through detachment (Vairagya) from the physical body-mind complex.

sanskrit_shloka: एवं मिथः समाधिः स्यात्सर्वसङ्कल्पवर्जितः । स्वदेहे पुत्रदारादिबान्धवेषु धनादिषु । सर्वेषु निर्ममो भूत्वा समाधिं समवाप्नुयात् ॥
text: एवं मिथः समाधिः स्यात्सर्वसङ्कल्पवर्जितः । स्वदेहे पुत्रदारादिबान्धवेषु धनादिषु । सर्वेषु निर्ममो भूत्वा समाधिं समवाप्नुयात् ॥
transliteration: evaṃ mithaḥ samādhiḥ syātsarvasaṅkalpavarjitaḥ | svadehe putradārādibāndhaveṣu dhanādiṣu | sarveṣu nirmamo bhūtvā samādhiṃ samavāpnuyāt ||
translation: Thus, let one attain the state of Samadhi, devoid of all mental constructs (Sankalpa). Remaining free from the sense of 'mine-ness' (attachment) toward one's own body, children, wife, relatives, and wealth, one should achieve this state of profound absorption.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Thus, let one attain the state of Samadhi, devoid of all mental constructs (Sankalpa). Remaining free from the sense of 'mine-ness' (attachment) toward one's own body, children, wife, relatives, and wealth, one should achieve this state of profound absorption.
translations.text: Thus, let one attain the state of Samadhi, devoid of all mental constructs (Sankalpa). Remaining free from the sense of 'mine-ness' (attachment) toward one's own body, children, wife, relatives, and wealth, one should achieve this state of profound absorption.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: इस प्रकार समस्त संकल्पों से रहित होकर समाधि का अभ्यास करना चाहिए। अपने शरीर, पुत्र, पत्नी, अन्य बन्धु-बान्धवों और धन-सम्पत्ति आदि समस्त वस्तुओं में 'ममत्व' (अहंकार) का त्याग करके साधक समाधि को प्राप्त करे।
translations.text: इस प्रकार समस्त संकल्पों से रहित होकर समाधि का अभ्यास करना चाहिए। अपने शरीर, पुत्र, पत्नी, अन्य बन्धु-बान्धवों और धन-सम्पत्ति आदि समस्त वस्तुओं में 'ममत्व' (अहंकार) का त्याग करके साधक समाधि को प्राप्त करे।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Samadhi (Meditative absorption)
commentary_faqs.answer: Nirmama (Non-attachment / detachment from worldly possessions and identity)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Psychological relief from stress, anxiety, and obsessive attachment to external worldly affairs by cultivating equanimity.

sanskrit_shloka: तत्त्वं लयामृतं गोप्यं शिवोक्तं विविधानि च । तेषां सङ्क्षेपमादाय कथितं मुक्तिलक्षणम् ॥
text: तत्त्वं लयामृतं गोप्यं शिवोक्तं विविधानि च । तेषां सङ्क्षेपमादाय कथितं मुक्तिलक्षणम् ॥
transliteration: tattvaṃ layāmṛtaṃ gopyaṃ śivoktaṃ vividhāni ca | teṣāṃ saṅkṣepamādāya kathitaṃ muktilakṣaṇam ||
translation: The truth, the secret nectar of dissolution (Laya), and the various teachings spoken by Shiva, all have been gathered in summary and explained here as the characteristics of liberation.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: The truth, the secret nectar of dissolution (Laya), and the various teachings spoken by Shiva, all have been gathered in summary and explained here as the characteristics of liberation.
translations.text: The truth, the secret nectar of dissolution (Laya), and the various teachings spoken by Shiva, all have been gathered in summary and explained here as the characteristics of liberation.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: तत्त्व, लय और अमृत तुल्य गोप्य विद्याएँ जो भगवान शिव द्वारा कही गई हैं, उन सबका सार ग्रहण करके यहाँ मुक्ति के लक्षण का वर्णन किया गया है।
translations.text: तत्त्व, लय और अमृत तुल्य गोप्य विद्याएँ जो भगवान शिव द्वारा कही गई हैं, उन सबका सार ग्रहण करके यहाँ मुक्ति के लक्षण का वर्णन किया गया है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Laya Yoga
commentary_faqs.answer: Synthesis of diverse Shaiva tantric doctrines leading to the state of liberation

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: The practice of Laya (dissolution of mental modifications) is effective in treating chronic stress, anxiety disorders, and psychosomatic imbalances by inducing deep relaxation and mental stillness.

sanskrit_shloka: इति ते कथितं चण्ड समाधिर्दुर्लभः परः । यं ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्जन्म जायते भूमिमण्डले ॥
text: इति ते कथितं चण्ड समाधिर्दुर्लभः परः । यं ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्जन्म जायते भूमिमण्डले ॥
transliteration: iti te kathitaṃ caṇḍa samādhir-durlabhaḥ paraḥ | yaṃ jñātvā na punarjanma jāyate bhūmimaṇḍale ||
translation: Thus, O Canda, has the supreme and rare Samadhi been described to you; having realized which, rebirth does not occur upon this earthly sphere.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Thus, O Canda, has the supreme and rare Samadhi been described to you; having realized which, rebirth does not occur upon this earthly sphere.
translations.text: Thus, O Canda, has the supreme and rare Samadhi been described to you; having realized which, rebirth does not occur upon this earthly sphere.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: हे चण्ड! इस प्रकार मैंने तुम्हें उस परम दुर्लभ समाधि का उपदेश दिया है; जिसे जान लेने पर इस पृथ्वी मण्डल पर पुनः जन्म नहीं होता है।
translations.text: हे चण्ड! इस प्रकार मैंने तुम्हें उस परम दुर्लभ समाधि का उपदेश दिया है; जिसे जान लेने पर इस पृथ्वी मण्डल पर पुनः जन्म नहीं होता है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Samadhi (Meditation)
commentary_faqs.answer: Moksha (Liberation from the cycle of rebirth)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: The practice of Samadhi is relevant in managing psychological distress, chronic anxiety, and stress-related disorders by inducing a state of deep neural quiescence.
